introHtml: Yellow stadium cups make your brand stand out in a crowd, whether at a company picnic, trade show, or tailgate. The bright color grabs attention and pairs well with white or black imprint for high contrast. Choose from 16 oz or 22 oz sizes, and decorate with screen printing or full-wrap digital printing. Perfect for marketing directors and event planners looking to boost visibility.
